$ go test  # pkg-a-circular
    the corpus directory script has two different corpus types:
          .: github.com/sdboyer/hypercase_test.Script: "Trees of instructions, under in/<tree>/, that the fixtures' columns follow."
          ./b: github.com/sdboyer/hypercase_test.Script: "Scripts."
        An archive's directory gives its type. Declare the type once, in a package the others import, and register that declaration. If they register one declaration already, a registry is stale: run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., which rewrites the registry of every package with tests.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
FAIL
[exit 1]
